statement: EVIOCGABS on every axis of virtual wired UHID returned (min, max, fuzz, flat, resolution): sticks ABS 0/1/3/4 (-32767, 32767, 0, 0, 6553); pads ABS 16-19 (-32767, 32767, 256, 0, 1638); triggers ABS 20/21 (0, 32767, 0, 0, 5461); sensor accel ABS 0-2 (-32768, 32768, 128, 0, 16384); sensor gyro ABS 3-5 (-32768, 32768, 0, 0, 16). The sensor property mask is 0x40 (INPUT_PROP_ACCELEROMETER) and the gamepad has none. These match every attribute in steam-c6-kernel-ibex-gamepad-evdev and steam-c6-kernel-ibex-sensor-evdev. Reduced uinput matches all ten gamepad minima, maxima and flat values but reports fuzz 0 and resolution 0 on every axis, a documented provider limitation rather than a golden disagreement for UHID.
